comments.text: John C. Calhoun’s name was also removed as the name of one of the residential colleges at Yale University.  It was renamed io honor Rear Admiral Grace Hopper one of the pioneering computer scientists and an alumna of Yale’s graduate school,  which predated Yale College’s decision to admit women as undergraduate students.

comments.text: Savannah is a unique, beautiful and special place, rich in southern culture. The waterfront, the parks, fountains, homes ornate with rod iron railings, the nearby forts, shops and restaurants, and much more. Having said that I'm very concerned about the high crime rate that has changed how I approach visiting Savannah.
